focus.rationale: T13 re-derivation (2026-09-10, permissive reading, §10.2.1): smoothing_route is cationic_alignment on a two-observation SFR-high read (film: Guar HPTC r11 + PQ-10 r12; lubrication: Dicaprylyl Carbonate r2, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate r4), clearing §7.4.1's two-observation test. COND high was over-satisfied (the LGN pair r3/r6 plus the rich emollient package r2/r4/r5/r9/r10 could each independently carry it), so under the conservative reading the cationic film read as baseline conditioning; under the now-adopted permissive reading, the LGN-pair-plus-emollient set leaves the cationic film beyond baseline. No qualifying repair route exists (R2 none_visible; claims[] has no C1/C2 marketing position at all, so the now-deleted T13a prong was never reachable here regardless). curl_definition fails the v0.3 negative gate (no C1/C2 curl/wave positioning or texture-targeted directions — this product's only source tier is C3-equivalent). Every other route fails its own gate (heat_styling: HEAT not_claimed; detangling: no C1/C2 positioning and WT high; volume_lightness: WT high; shine: would restate the smoothing film, G3). This record's pre-T13 `focus` uncertain_fields entry — recorded because the §10.2.1 reading, not the evidence, decided it — is removed: the reading is now a settled rule, not an open call.
focus.derivation: §10.2: qualifying routes are collected beyond baseline conditioning (§10.2.1, permissive reading T13b), then the rank order repair > smoothing > curl_definition > heat_styling > detangling > volume_lightness > shine binds.
thresholdReasoning: Selected primary `smoothing` with secondary [].
§10.2 principle 4: official positioning may corroborate a route but never creates one.
limitations: A focus is a statement of distinctive purpose, not an efficacy claim or a measured endpoint.
